title: Times Tables & Division

scenes.t: Multiplying is adding equal groups. A sandwich costs LE 4, so 6 sandwiches cost 6 × 4 = LE 24.
We can multiply in any order: 7 × 5 = 5 × 7 = 35. This is called the commutative law.
To multiply by 10, the digits move one place left: 10 × 7 = 70 and 80 × 4 = 320 (8 × 4 = 32, then ×10).
Dividing is sharing into equal groups. 35 ÷ 5 = 7 and 48 ÷ 4 = 12. Dividing by 10 moves digits right: 490 ÷ 10 = 49.
Sometimes there is a remainder. 63 ÷ 5 = 12 remainder 3, because 12 × 5 = 60 and 3 are left over.
Iman needs 55 circles. Each sticker sheet has 5 circles. 55 ÷ 5 = 11 sheets.
Know your tables! Numbers in the 5 times table end in 0 or 5. Numbers in the 4 times table are all even: 8, 36 ...

items.a: What is left over after dividing.

activities.title: Memory: Facts
activities.prompt: Match each sum with its answer.

activities.title: In the 5 Times Table?
activities.prompt: Is it in the 5 times table?

why.n: It does not end in 0 or 5.

items.q: A sandwich costs LE 4. What do 6 cost?
Water costs LE 2 a bottle. How many bottles for LE 18?
Iman needs 55 circles. A sheet has 5 circles. How many sheets?

items.hint: How many 5s fit in 63? What is left?

items.q: 4 packs of 8 cups. How many cups?
A box has 10 apples. How many in 8 boxes?
Which numbers are both in the 4 times table?
Which operation finds the cups in 4 packs of 8?
Which number is in the 5 times table?
